classes.name: MockHandler
classes.description: A handler class for mocking HTTP responses or exceptions from a queue, used primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: createWithMiddleware
methods.description: Creates a HandlerStack with a new MockHandler instance, allowing middleware integration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MockHandler with an optional queue of responses, and optional callbacks for fulfilled and rejected promises.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles an incoming request by returning a queued response or throwing an exception, with support for delays and header callbacks.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds responses, exceptions, callables, or promises to the queue.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last request received by the handler.

methods.name: getLastOptions
methods.description: Returns the options used in the last request.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining items in the queue.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Invokes the on_stats callback with transfer statistics.
